question: After the PDF resource guard is repaired, should ClickClack core ship and maintain this six-format artifact viewer and its new browser parsing dependencies?
rationale: The patch adds a substantial user-facing core surface and long-term parsing and security ownership without existing maintainer discussion confirming that product boundary.

options.title: Repair and sponsor the viewer
options.body: Land the bounded viewer after focused safety validation and accept ongoing ownership of its format parsers and dependencies.

options.title: Narrow the initial format set
options.body: Ship only formats already supported by existing dependencies and defer DOCX or code highlighting to reduce maintenance and security surface.

options.title: Keep download-only documents
options.body: Decline the new core viewer surface and retain the existing bounded attachment and download behavior.

recommendation.title: Repair and sponsor the viewer
recommendation.body: Land the bounded viewer after focused safety validation and accept ongoing ownership of its format parsers and dependencies.

likelyOwner.reason: The current attachment surface and release baseline trace most directly to his history, making him the best available owner for the core product-boundary choice.
